decisions: MaintenanceErrors es plana: MaintenanceErrors.RoutineAlreadyExists, .MaintenancePlanNotFound, etc. (nombre = codigo sin punto). Tambien UpdatedByRequired, RoutineTypeNameRequired, AlertAcknowledgedByR…
ValueObject del repo es abstract record sin GetEqualityComponents: los VOs son sealed record con ctor privado y propiedades get-only. Km como long; intervalos y overrides como int?.

EffectiveRoutineParameters.Resolve recibe (MaintenanceInterval, DueSoonThreshold, RoutineOverrides), no RoutineTypeParameters; expone Interval/DueSoonThreshold y 3 fuentes. Meses de intervalo max 1200…
AlertRaised y AlertStatusChanged llevan campos planos (ids, placa, ruta, ciclo) en vez de AlertOrigin, para no depender de ese VO; Alert debe volcarlos al emitir.
Se asumen enums de Plans y Alerts en sus namespaces raiz, ids en Common, LicensePlate/NextDue/ServiceRecord en Plans.ValueObjects y RoutineTypeCode en RoutineTypes.ValueObjects.
RoutineStatusSnapshot usa NextDue (VO) en vez de NextDueKm/NextDueDate; EffectiveDueSoonPercent es decimal. El mapper convierte al contrato.

decisions: IHasRowVersion lives in Infrastructure.Persistence (not Domain): aggregates implementing it need a reference to Infrastructure; ask orchestrator if it should move to Domain.
Task 4.3 interceptor should call OutboxMessageFactory.Create(event, subject) and add it to the context; stream/EventName are read from the event's const fields.
Publisher takes plain DbContext (DI must map DbContext to the service context); EfEventCheckpointStore.SaveAsync only stages, the unit of work commits.
ReportFailureCommand returns ICommand<bool> (true on success) because BuildingBlocks has no Unit type.
Handlers are plain classes without DI registration; Hub/composition must register them (or use AddCommandHandlers) and the IEventStore.
Handlers also validate stream/streams non-empty, offsets >= 0, max >= 1; error text is truncated to 2000 chars.
Services must call services.AddApiJsonConventions() and app.UseCorrelationId() explicitly; they are not wired automatically.
ToHttpResult on a successful Result returns 204 NoContent; on Result<T> returns 200 Ok(value). ProblemDetails title is the ErrorType name.
IEndpointModule implementations need a public parameterless constructor (Activator.CreateInstance).
Future services are added by appending assembly names to ArchitectureAssemblies.AssemblyNames; the layer, isolation, setter, enum and naming rules pick them up by suffix.
Snapshot comparison is semantic (JsonNode.DeepEquals), so formatting differences in the .approved.json files do not fail the test.

decisions: AddOutboxRelay requires the host to register IClock and the TContext DbContext; the batch processor is scoped and resolved per cycle by OutboxRelayService.
Transport is registered with TryAddSingleton so several AddOutboxRelay<TContext> calls in one host share a single EventBusPublisher.
A failure while deserializing a payload is treated as a delivery failure (RegisterFailure) and stops the batch, preserving order.

HandleFamily<TMarker,...> requires TMarker : IIntegrationEvent (needed for IIntegrationEventHandler<TMarker>); IRoutineSnapshotEvent/IServiceOrderSnapshotEvent do not extend it, so they must to be usa…
Registry key is the EventName; the dispatcher extracts it from envelope.Type (rutaviva.{svc}.{Name}.v1 -> Name, or the raw type if not in that format).
Host/dispatcher are internal; the service must register its own scoped IEventCheckpointStore and IUnitOfWork for Checkpoint (Latest gets in-memory and null defaults via TryAdd).
